The world was tired of existence.
So it gave birth to a monster.
He who devours all.
He whom even Gods dread.
He who stands beyond Infinity.

Evil. Cunning. Ruthless.

But innocence was merely a disguise.
As he grew, so did his hunger.
Worlds became prey.
Gods became stepping stones.
Infinity became nothing more than another boundary to devour.
And eventually, he became the greatest terror the universe had ever witnessed.

It was his System.
The System claimed that its sole purpose was to create the Ultimate Devourer of the Universe.

However, many things had changed. One of the most significant was the sudden appearance of a Tower, a mysterious structure that had appeared across all the continents, granting power to those brave enough to contest its challenges.
“Not again... With this chance I will end you all” Neraxis vowed to himself, embarking on his path of revenge, while also trying to give his life new meaning.
the-void-wolf: A ritual, with the sole purpose of obtaining immortality, goes horribly wrong. What's left in its aftermath is a boy who receives an inheritance from the Void, a mysterious place that embodies darkness. With a newfound power, he is given a chance to carve his own way into the world.
tribal-system-conquering-the-wild-women-:
A brilliant mechanical engineer dies the most fitting death for his scandalous reputation distracted by the plant manager's breathtaking ass, he completely misses the pressure gauge warning, and the boiler blows him to smithereens.
Instead of the afterlife, his soul transmigrates into the body of “Little Flame” a frail tribal youth who just kicked the bucket from an overdose of mystical Night Lily powder.
To his absolute bewilderment, he wakes up inside a primitive hut with his voluptuous aunt desperately riding him, trying to get pregnant so the tribal chief won't sell her off as livestock.
Armed with the mind of a modern engineer and a newly awakened “Tribal System” that demands he expand his territory and his bloodline, the new Little Flame decides to seize control.
The weak boy of the clan is gone, it’s time to use modern technology to drag this tribe out of the Stone Age, crush rival clans, and conquer the wildest women of the untamed lands.
After all, to build an empire from scratch, a man needs two things a heavy club to smash his enemies, and an equally relentless “club” for the sheets.
[Kingdom Building - Wild Harem - Explicit Smut - Technological Progress].
warriors-promise:
The course of commitments never did run smooth.
After dying on Earth, the King of Mercenaries is reborn as Su Mo in the Firmament and Continent. In this brand-new world, Martial Art is the way of life, and the strong set the rules.
Having awakened a Martial Soul of the lowest rank, possibly meaning he will never go far as a Martial Artist, Su Mo is determined to rise to the top again nonetheless.
However, misfortunes never come singly. The love of his life is soon taken by one of the most powerful forces in the world. With no time to spare, watch as Su Mo overcomes all odds and struggle on the verge of death countless times, in order to meet his love again.
As the protagonist reaches the top in that world, he has to take on more responsibilities and face new challenges.
Follow Su Mo on his relentless journey to become stronger for the sake of those important to him, and uncover the deep, dark secrets and plots in the vast universe.
who-let-him-cultivate-wx:
The next day.
“I’ve stressed this time and again—I’m responsible for making the ethos of the cultivation world off-kilter! History is written by the victors, and I’ve triumphed!” Sword Immortal Lu Yang expressed his ire during a press interview.
—Brought to you by The Cultivation Times.
(Translated by Rakumon)
It is the first day of the twelfth month of the year—a suitable day for the launch of this novel (I hope… :3) I am Rakumon, the translator of Who Let Him Cultivate?! This novel is known for its refreshing humor and imaginative ideas in the Chinese community. If you like a witty protagonist, interesting side characters, a mystery plot in the background, and plenty of comedy, do read on and be a part of Lu Yang’s journey!
I have previously worked on Consort of a Thousand Faces and Transmigration: Of Mysteries And Songs on Volare. It will be my first time translating a novel from this genre, and it definitely doesn’t help that this novel is heavy with jokes, puns, wordplay, memes, poems, cultural references—you name it. Nonetheless, I will try my best to bring them across to all of you, and please also feel free to share your comments!
zombie-domination:
Dominion of the Dead
As the world collapses under a zombie outbreak, Julian Deaw only wants to survive. But after being betrayed and thrown away as bait, he discovers something that shouldn’t exist a game-like power [Domination].
Now, with a zombie by his side, Julian must choose: to save what’s left of the world… or to rule over its ruins.
